fields.bio:
Mara opened the salon side of the house and still cuts most Saturdays. She cuts curls dry, one at a time, and colours for the way hair grows out.

She will tell you when a cut will not suit you. Most people come back for that.
fields.credentials:
Trained in London and Lisbon
Curly cut specialist
Fifteen years behind the chair

fields.bio:
Noor leads the massage rooms. She works slowly and asks a lot of questions first, so the hour goes where you need it.

Deep tissue is hers; so is the prenatal bolster, which she designed.
fields.credentials:
LMT, 12 years
Prenatal massage certificate
Sports massage diploma

fields.bio: June looks after skin. Every first facial starts with a consultation with her, and every facial ends with her notes on what to use at home.

seo.description: A day spa and salon on Alder Street: massage, facials, hair, nails, makeup and a studio upstairs.

/privacy.title: Privacy
/privacy.content:
Juniper House keeps the details you send through our forms to reply to you and to book your appointments. We do not sell them or share them with anyone else.

What we keep

Your name, phone number, email and the notes you choose to add.

How long

Two years after your last visit, then we delete them. Ask us and we will delete them sooner.

/terms.title: Terms
/terms.content:
Prices are in US dollars and include the time on the menu. Gift cards are sent by email and do not expire.

Appointments

Cancel or move an appointment up to a day ahead at no charge. Inside a day we charge half the treatment.

fields.bio:
Mara opened the salon side of the house and still cuts most Saturdays. She cuts curls dry, one at a time, and colours for the way hair grows out.

She will tell you when a cut will not suit you. Most people come back for that.
fields.credentials:
Trained in London and Lisbon
Curly cut specialist
Fifteen years behind the chair

fields.bio:
Noor leads the massage rooms. She works slowly and asks a lot of questions first, so the hour goes where you need it.

Deep tissue is hers; so is the prenatal bolster, which she designed.
fields.credentials:
LMT, 12 years
Prenatal massage certificate
Sports massage diploma

fields.bio: June looks after skin. Every first facial starts with a consultation with her, and every facial ends with her notes on what to use at home.
fields.credentials:

Advanced chemical peels
LED therapy course

fields.bio: Tess runs the nail bar by the front window: clean lines, quiet colours and the occasional painted moon.
